title: A test leaves a real gate running that holds a slot
what: No test leaves a gate process running after it ends, and a test's gate never takes a slot from the machine's real slot folder: every test that starts `relay gate` waits for it or kills it, and runs with its own RELAY_HOME.
why: Seen 26 Oct: process 72877, `/Users/amidman/relay/.worktrees/setup-wt-market/bin/relay gate`, parent PID 1 (orphaned), working folder /private/var/folders/.../T/relay-gate-uiubjo2c/main/.worktrees/x, running 3 h 42 min; with three slots per machine, the real gates of setup-scope and tests-tmp waited ("gate: waiting for a free gate slot (3 busy)"), and the agents waiting on them ran out of turns. The front's kill of it was refused by the permission classifier; the owner was asked. Relates to every-test-runs-with-temporary-relay-and-claude.
failing_case: After the setup-wt-market branch's test run, a `relay gate` process from a temporary relay copy is still running hours later and holds a real gate slot.
pass_cases: After the full test suite, `pgrep -f "relay gate"` lists no process whose folder is a test's temporary folder; a test's gate takes slots only under its temporary RELAY_HOME.
where: tests/test_setup.py or the test that runs `relay gate` inside a temporary relay copy (temp folder relay-gate-*/main/.worktrees/x)
